dragon_cape.description: Dragon cape, cosmetic cape. Magic +8. Dragonfire from the chained dragon cannot pass it.

ring_angels.name: The Ring of Angels
ring_angels.description: The Ring of Angels. Worn, it saves you when a hit leaves you below one fifth of your hitpoints, by carrying you to Ashvale. It rests for an hour between saves, or ten minutes once Iria has given you the Gift of Angels.

bones.name: Bones
bones.description: Bones, resource bones. Bury them for Prayer XP. From the valley of Ashvale.

big_bones.name: Big bones
big_bones.description: Big bones, resource bones. Bury them for Prayer XP. From the valley of Ashvale.

hero_bones.name: Hero's Bones
hero_bones.description: The scorched bones of Sir Garran, the Hero of Ashvale. His squire is waiting on the path below the ruined keep.
hero_bones.examine: Sir Garran's scorched remains. Bring them to Squire Elian on the path northwest of the ruined keep.

dragonheart_key.name: Dragon-Heart Key
dragonheart_key.description: Father Aldous's old iron key for the hatch beneath the chained dragon's ruined keep.
dragonheart_key.examine: An old iron key shaped like a flame around a heart. It opens the hatch inside the ruined keep.

monk_robe.name: Monk's robe
monk_robe.description: A monk's robe of undyed wool, given by the chapel in Saltmere for the Wayside Prayer. Magic +1, Prayer +3. Adds a full second to each prayer point on top of any other Prayer bonus.

robe_linen.name: Linen robe
robe_linen.description: Linen robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_linen.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

robe_red.name: Red robe
robe_red.description: Red robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_red.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

robe_blue.name: Blue robe
robe_blue.description: Blue robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_blue.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

robe_green.name: Green robe
robe_green.description: Green robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_green.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

robe_purple.name: Purple robe
robe_purple.description: Purple robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_purple.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

robe_black.name: Black robe
robe_black.description: Black robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_black.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

robe_gold.name: Gold robe
robe_gold.description: Gold robe, cosmetic robe. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
robe_gold.examine: A plain robe with a touch of the arcane in the weave.

vorthan_robe.name: Vorthan robe
vorthan_robe.description: An orange hooded robe of the Red Pyre. Magic +2, Prayer +4. Adds two seconds to each prayer point on top of any other Prayer bonus. Found in the Spider Cave on Edric's bones.

vorth_rosary.name: Vorth's rosary
vorth_rosary.description: A string of burnt-orange beads. Worn in the shield hand: Magic +2, Prayer +4, and two seconds added to each prayer point (same as a Vorthan robe). Once Mother Wenna has sent you for the keeper's beads, using them carries you to the mouth of the Spider Cave southeast of Whisperwood — and they still know that cave after the errand is done. A necklace you have not been sent to use will not know the prayer.

edric_note.name: Edric's note
edric_note.description: A damp scrap in a Vorthan's hand. It names the Red Pyre, the rosary, and the cave. Mother Wenna of Saltmere is meant to read it.
edric_note.examine: A damp note in a Vorthan's hand naming the Red Pyre, the rosary and the cave. Take it to Mother Wenna in Saltmere (The Red Pyre).

sapling.name: Sapling
sapling.description: A young shoot. Plant it in open ground, or in a stump, and it will stand up as a tree.

oak_sapling.name: Oak sapling
oak_sapling.description: A broad-leafed young oak. Plant it in open ground, or in a stump, and it will grow into an oak tree.

yew_sapling.name: Yew sapling
yew_sapling.description: A dark evergreen shoot carrying the altar's old magic. Plant it in open ground, or in a stump, and it will grow into a yew tree.

brambleheart_maul.name: Brambleheart maul
brambleheart_maul.description: A stone-headed maul grown through with Bramble's living roots. Attack +12, Strength +20. Each attack has a 25% chance to root its target, slowing it for four ticks.

bow_evenflight.name: Evenflight bow
bow_evenflight.description: Keel's perfectly balanced double-recurve bow. Ranged +25, Speed 4, Range 8. Its brass weights hold every ordinary arrow to an unusually true line.

staff_stillwind.name: Stillwind staff
staff_stillwind.description: Gale's deliberate staff, its silver rings holding a pocket of motionless air. Magic +24, Speed 6, Range 9. Each unsplashed cast has a 20% chance to stun its target for two ticks.

verdant_wreath.name: Verdant wreath
verdant_wreath.description: A circlet of living leaves, worn on the crown. Magic +1, Prayer +3. Adds a full second to each prayer point, the same blessing as a monk's robe.

wild_rice.name: Wild rice
wild_rice.description: Manoomin, wild rice, resource grain. Knocked from the stalks into a canoe on the lake below Ziibiing. From the valley of Ashvale.

fighter_boots.name: Fighter boots
fighter_boots.description: Heavy leather and iron boots from the Ashen Crown. Strength +10, Defence +4. They put real weight behind a melee blow.

dried_mouse.name: Dried mouse
dried_mouse.description: Waawaabiganoojiinh, a dried mouse. Mishoomis's really special gift for twenty handfuls of manoomin. Nobody knows what it is for. From the valley of Ashvale.

prayer_potion.description: Prayer potion, potion healing. Restores 25% of your Prayer points. Made in the valley of Ashvale.

dragon_bones.description: Dragon bones, resource bones. Bury them for a great deal of Prayer XP. From the ruined keep.

castle_stone.description: Lake Castle stone, tool stone. Teleport castle, Cooldown ticks 3000. Call to arms: the castle guard comes to your side. Made in the valley of Ashvale.

mutton_raw.name: Raw mutton
mutton_raw.description: Raw mutton, resource meat. Cooking level 6, Cooking XP 40. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
mutton_raw.examine: Raw mutton. Cook it on a range or fire for roast mutton.

mutton_cooked.name: Roast mutton
mutton_cooked.description: Roast mutton, food meat. Heal 5. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
mutton_cooked.examine: Roast mutton. Heals 5; the castle's chaplain asks for some (Vespers).

mutton_burnt.name: Burnt mutton
mutton_burnt.description: Burnt mutton, resource meat. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
mutton_burnt.examine: Burnt mutton. Good for nothing but a lesson.

beef_raw.name: Raw beef
beef_raw.description: Raw beef, resource meat. Cooking level 10, Cooking XP 55. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
beef_raw.examine: Raw beef. Cook it on a range or fire.

beef_cooked.name: Roast beef
beef_cooked.description: Roast beef, food meat. Heal 7. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
beef_cooked.examine: Roast beef. Heals well; the castle kitchens buy it.

beef_burnt.name: Burnt beef
beef_burnt.description: Burnt beef, resource meat. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
beef_burnt.examine: Burnt beef. The dogs won't touch it either.

wool.name: Wool
wool.description: Wool, resource fleece. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
wool.examine: A fleece of wool from the castle's sheep. Keeper Wyn wants one as an offering (The Three Stones); it also sells.

cowhide.name: Cowhide
cowhide.description: Cowhide, resource pelt. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
cowhide.examine: A cowhide from the castle farm. Tanners and the castle's stores buy them.

frost_ink.name: Frost ink
frost_ink.description: A pot of the Frostspire's ink, pale blue and cold enough to sting. The Circle writes with it because it does not fade, and the frost goblins steal it because it is shiny.
frost_ink.examine: A pot of the Frostspire's frost ink. Frost goblins steal it; Archmage Halvard wants three back (The Stolen Ink).

wizard_focus.name: Wizard's focus
wizard_focus.description: A sphere of summit ice that has not melted since the Ember King's chain was forged, held up on a silver stem. Archmage Halvard gives it to those who pass his trial. Held in the shield hand it adds 5 to your Magic bonus: your spells find their mark more often (it sharpens the aim, not the blow - a spell still hits as hard as it ever did). Needs Magic 30.
wizard_focus.examine: An ice orb on a silver stem, from The Archmage's Trial. Held in the shield hand: Magic +5, so your spells land more often.

tome_stones.name: Tome of Stones
tome_stones.description: The Circle's second book: the Three Stones at the shrine were the first wardens of the mountain, wizards who stood their watch so long they forgot to stop. Wyn swears they still hum the hours.
tome_stones.examine: The Circle's Tome of Stones, from Wyn. Show it to Pell at the Frostspire (The Scattered Tomes); yours to keep after.

tome_echoes.name: Tome of Echoes
tome_echoes.description: The Circle's first book: the mountain was raised to be a watchtower, and every echo on it is a word the watchers once said aloud and the stone kept. Aled has read it so often he answers it.
tome_echoes.examine: The Circle's Tome of Echoes, from Aled. Show it to Pell at the Frostspire (The Scattered Tomes); yours to keep after, for its lore.

wizard_cloak.name: Wizard cloak top
wizard_cloak.description: The upper half of the Circle of the Long Night's cloak, deep blue and lined with silver thread that holds the cold out and the magic in; wear the bottoms with it. Magic +10, Defence +12. Needs Magic 40. Sold at the Frostspire.
wizard_cloak.examine: The upper half of the Circle's cloak. Worn on the body: Magic +10, Defence +12. Needs Magic 40; sold by Pell at the Frostspire.

tome_far_road.name: Tome of the Far Road
tome_far_road.description: The Circle's third book: a map of the roads beyond the mountain, and a warning in frost ink that the Ember King's chain was forged on this summit and must be kept cold here, or it will soften there.
tome_far_road.examine: The Circle's Tome of the Far Road, from Tamsin. Show it to Pell (The Scattered Tomes); its last page warns of the chain.

wizard_cloak_bottoms.name: Wizard cloak bottoms
wizard_cloak_bottoms.description: The long skirts of the Circle's cloak, the hem bound in leather so it does not snag on the mountain's rocks. Magic +7, Defence +8. Needs Magic 40. Sold at the Frostspire.
wizard_cloak_bottoms.examine: The Circle's cloak skirts. Worn on the legs: Magic +7, Defence +8. Needs Magic 40; sold by Pell at the Frostspire.

thornwatch_stone.name: Thornwatch stone
thornwatch_stone.description: Thornwatch stone, tool stone. Teleport thornwatch, Cooldown ticks 3000. Made in the valley of Ashvale.

town_portal_scroll.name: Scroll of town portal
town_portal_scroll.description: Scroll of town portal. Read it and a door opens to the nearest town portal; step back through any town portal once to return to where you read it. One use. Found in the Hollow Den.

rake.name: Rake
rake.description: A sturdy rake. Use it on a farming patch to clear the weeds before you plant.
rake.examine: A sturdy rake. Use it on a farming patch to clear the weeds before you plant.

seed_dibber.name: Seed dibber
seed_dibber.description: A pointed stick for poking seeds into soil. Needed to plant anything in a farming patch.
seed_dibber.examine: A pointed stick for poking seeds into soil. Needed to plant anything in a farming patch.

spade.name: Spade
spade.description: A good iron spade. Dig up a farming patch's crop with it once the crop is fully grown.
spade.examine: A good iron spade. Dig up a farming patch's crop with it once the crop is fully grown.

watering_can.name: Watering can
watering_can.description: A watering can. Water a growing crop once for a bigger harvest; it refills itself from the dew, apparently.
watering_can.examine: A watering can. Water a growing crop once for a bigger harvest; it refills itself from the dew, apparently.

potato_seed.name: Potato seed
potato_seed.description: Potato seeds (Farming 1). Plant in any farming patch; potatoes are ready in about 8 blocks.
potato_seed.examine: Potato seeds (Farming 1). Plant in any farming patch; potatoes are ready in about 8 blocks.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: A potato, dug from your own patch. Eat it raw if you must (heals 1); it sells to the general stores.
potato.examine: A potato, dug from your own patch. Eat it raw if you must (heals 1); it sells to the general stores.

onion_seed.name: Onion seed
onion_seed.description: Onion seeds (Farming 5). Plant in any farming patch; onions are ready in about 12 blocks.
onion_seed.examine: Onion seeds (Farming 5). Plant in any farming patch; onions are ready in about 12 blocks.

onion.name: Onion
onion.description: An onion. Eat it if you are brave (heals 2), or sell it; cooks pay well for them.
onion.examine: An onion. Eat it if you are brave (heals 2), or sell it; cooks pay well for them.

cabbage_seed.name: Cabbage seed
cabbage_seed.description: Cabbage seeds (Farming 9). Plant in any farming patch; cabbages are ready in about 16 blocks.
cabbage_seed.examine: Cabbage seeds (Farming 9). Plant in any farming patch; cabbages are ready in about 16 blocks.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.description: A cabbage. Heals 3 if you eat it; the lodge on the mountain puts them in every stew.
cabbage.examine: A cabbage. Heals 3 if you eat it; the lodge on the mountain puts them in every stew.

barley_seed.name: Barley seed
barley_seed.description: Barley seeds (Farming 14). Needs a farming patch or a large one, not a small patch; about 20 blocks.
barley_seed.examine: Barley seeds (Farming 14). Needs a farming patch or a large one, not a small patch; about 20 blocks.

barley.name: Barley
barley.description: A sheaf of barley, for the mill and the brewers. Not food on its own; it sells well.
barley.examine: A sheaf of barley, for the mill and the brewers. Not food on its own; it sells well.

strawberry_seed.name: Strawberry seed
strawberry_seed.description: Strawberry seeds (Farming 19). Needs a farming patch or a large one; ripe in about 25 blocks.
strawberry_seed.examine: Strawberry seeds (Farming 19). Needs a farming patch or a large one; ripe in about 25 blocks.

strawberry.name: Strawberry
strawberry.description: A ripe strawberry. Heals 6 and tastes like summer.
strawberry.examine: A ripe strawberry. Heals 6 and tastes like summer.

pumpkin_seed.name: Pumpkin seed
pumpkin_seed.description: Pumpkin seeds (Farming 27). Needs a farming patch or a large one; slow, about 35 blocks.
pumpkin_seed.examine: Pumpkin seeds (Farming 27). Needs a farming patch or a large one; slow, about 35 blocks.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.description: A pumpkin. Heals 8 if you can face eating that much pumpkin.
pumpkin.examine: A pumpkin. Heals 8 if you can face eating that much pumpkin.

moonleaf_seed.name: Moonleaf seed
moonleaf_seed.description: Moonleaf seeds (Farming 33). Only a large farming patch will take them; about 40 blocks.
moonleaf_seed.examine: Moonleaf seeds (Farming 33). Only a large farming patch will take them; about 40 blocks.

moonleaf.name: Moonleaf
moonleaf.description: A silver moonleaf. The wizards of the Frostspire grind it into their frost ink; worth a good deal.
moonleaf.examine: A silver moonleaf. The wizards of the Frostspire grind it into their frost ink; worth a good deal.

frostbloom_seed.name: Frostbloom seed
frostbloom_seed.description: Frostbloom seeds (Farming 45). Only a large farming patch; about 60 blocks, and worth every one.
frostbloom_seed.examine: Frostbloom seeds (Farming 45). Only a large farming patch; about 60 blocks, and worth every one.

frostbloom.name: Frostbloom
frostbloom.description: A frostbloom, cold to the touch and faintly glowing. Rare, and prized by every wizard in the valley.
frostbloom.examine: A frostbloom, cold to the touch and faintly glowing. Rare, and prized by every wizard in the valley.

apprentice_hat.name: Apprentice hat
apprentice_hat.description: A dusty-blue cap that helps your first spells land. Magic +2. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
apprentice_hat.examine: A dusty-blue cap that helps your first spells land.

apprentice_top.name: Apprentice robe top
apprentice_top.description: A robe top aiding spell success, softer than steel. Magic +4, Defence +2. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
apprentice_top.examine: A robe top aiding spell success, softer than steel.

apprentice_bottoms.name: Apprentice robe bottoms
apprentice_bottoms.description: Robe bottoms that boost magic accuracy over plate. Magic +3, Defence +1. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
apprentice_bottoms.examine: Robe bottoms that boost magic accuracy over plate.

adept_hat.name: Adept hat
adept_hat.description: A teal hood sharpening spell hits while keeping warmth. Magic +3, Defence +1. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
adept_hat.examine: A teal hood sharpening spell hits while keeping warmth.

adept_top.name: Adept robe top
adept_top.description: Teal robes that guide spells better than metal armor. Magic +5, Defence +4. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
adept_top.examine: Teal robes that guide spells better than metal armor.

adept_bottoms.name: Adept robe bottoms
adept_bottoms.description: Robe bottoms offering magic help with solid protection. Magic +4, Defence +2. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
adept_bottoms.examine: Robe bottoms offering magic help with solid protection.

mystic_hat.name: Mystic hat
mystic_hat.description: A deep purple cap ensuring your high-level spells land. Magic +4, Defence +2. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
mystic_hat.examine: A deep purple cap ensuring your high-level spells land.

mystic_top.name: Mystic robe top
mystic_top.description: Purple robes that boost spell accuracy without ruining casting. Magic +7, Defence +6. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
mystic_top.examine: Purple robes that boost spell accuracy without ruining casting.

mystic_bottoms.name: Mystic robe bottoms
mystic_bottoms.description: Mystic bottoms that aid magic while offering steel-like defense. Magic +5, Defence +4. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
mystic_bottoms.examine: Mystic bottoms that aid magic while offering steel-like defense.

arcane_hat.name: Arcane hat
arcane_hat.description: A near-black hat with silver thread for perfect spell hits. Magic +5, Defence +3. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
arcane_hat.examine: A near-black hat with silver thread for perfect spell hits.

arcane_top.name: Arcane robe top
arcane_top.description: Arcane robes that maximize magic success while resisting steel. Magic +8, Defence +9. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
arcane_top.examine: Arcane robes that maximize magic success while resisting steel.

arcane_bottoms.name: Arcane robe bottoms
arcane_bottoms.description: Silver-stitched bottoms aiding spells without blocking magic. Magic +6, Defence +6. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
arcane_bottoms.examine: Silver-stitched bottoms aiding spells without blocking magic.

circle_hat.name: Circle hat
circle_hat.description: The tall blue Circle hat that sharpens spells for wizards. Magic +6, Defence +4. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
circle_hat.examine: The tall blue Circle hat that sharpens spells for wizards.

leather_coif.name: Leather coif
leather_coif.description: Leather coif: helps arrows land. Ranged +2, Defence +2. Made in the valley of Ashvale.

leather_body.name: Leather body
leather_body.description: Leather body armor protecting better than robes but less than steel. Ranged +5, Defence +5. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
leather_body.examine: Leather body armor protecting better than robes but less than steel.

leather_chaps.name: Leather chaps
leather_chaps.description: Leather chaps shielding legs from arrows while aiding range. Ranged +3, Defence +3. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
leather_chaps.examine: Leather chaps shielding legs from arrows while aiding range.

leather_boots.name: Leather boots
leather_boots.description: Leather boots protecting feet and helping arrows land far. Ranged +1, Defence +1. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
leather_boots.examine: Leather boots protecting feet and helping arrows land far.

studded_coif.name: Studded coif
studded_coif.description: Studded coif: helps arrows land. Ranged +4, Defence +4. Made in the valley of Ashvale.

studded_body.name: Studded body
studded_body.description: Studded body armor protecting better than robes, less than plate. Ranged +9, Defence +9. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
studded_body.examine: Studded body armor protecting better than robes, less than plate.

studded_chaps.name: Studded chaps
studded_chaps.description: Iron-studded chaps that shield legs while aiding arrow accuracy. Ranged +6, Defence +6. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
studded_chaps.examine: Iron-studded chaps that shield legs while aiding arrow accuracy.

studded_boots.name: Studded boots
studded_boots.description: Studded boots protecting feet and helping arrows fly true. Ranged +2, Defence +2. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
studded_boots.examine: Studded boots protecting feet and helping arrows fly true.

wolfhide_coif.name: Wolfhide coif
wolfhide_coif.description: Wolfhide coif: helps arrows land. Ranged +6, Defence +6. Made in the valley of Ashvale.

wolfhide_body.name: Wolfhide body
wolfhide_body.description: Wolfhide body armor protecting better than robes, less than steel. Ranged +14, Defence +14. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
wolfhide_body.examine: Wolfhide body armor protecting better than robes, less than steel.

wolfhide_boots.description: Furry wolfhide boots protecting feet and helping arrows land. Ranged +3, Defence +3. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
wolfhide_boots.examine: Furry wolfhide boots protecting feet and helping arrows land.

frosthide_boots.description: Pale hide boots protecting feet and helping arrows fly true. Ranged +4, Defence +4. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
frosthide_boots.examine: Pale hide boots protecting feet and helping arrows fly true.

dragonhide_boots.description: Dragonhide boots protecting feet and helping arrows land far. Ranged +6, Defence +6. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
dragonhide_boots.examine: Dragonhide boots protecting feet and helping arrows land far.

hat_wizard.examine: A proper wizard's hat, pointed and starry.

captain_cutlass.name: Captain's cutlass
captain_cutlass.description: Captain Ruark's lucky cutlass: a gilt basket hilt and a nick for every lie he has told. Take it back to him (The Captain's Cutlass).
captain_cutlass.examine: Captain Ruark's lucky cutlass: a gilt basket hilt and a nick for every lie he has told. Take it back to him (The Captain's Cutlass).

cutlass.name: Cutlass
cutlass.description: A pirate's cutlass, short and curved, from Captain Ruark. Attack +14, Strength +13. Needs Attack 15.
cutlass.examine: A pirate's cutlass, short and curved, from Captain Ruark. Attack +14, Strength +13. Needs Attack 15.

sea_salt.name: Sea salt
sea_salt.description: A twist of Nettie's sea salt. Grizz wants it for his stew (Fish Stew Again).
sea_salt.examine: A twist of Nettie's sea salt. Grizz wants it for his stew (Fish Stew Again).

tarred_rope.name: Tarred rope
tarred_rope.description: A coil of rope tarred against the sea. Bryce the shipwright stitches sails with it (Black Sails); Sela sells it.
tarred_rope.examine: A coil of rope tarred against the sea. Bryce the shipwright stitches sails with it (Black Sails); Sela sells it.

sail_canvas.name: Sail canvas

sail_canvas.examine: A bolt of heavy sail canvas from Sela's chandlery. Enough for a mainsail (Black Sails).

pirate_stew.name: Pirate's stew
pirate_stew.description: A bowl of Grizz's stew with real potatoes and onions in it. Heals 14. Made at a fire from 3 potatoes, 3 onions, sea salt and a shrimp.

hat_tricorn.name: Captain's tricorn

hat_tricorn.examine: Captain Ruark's spare tricorn, given for Black Sails. It makes you look like you own a ship, or at least a strong opinion about one.

radish_seed.name: Radish seed

radish.name: Radish

gwens_hammer.name: Gwen's hammer
gwens_hammer.description: Gwen's hammer, tool hammer. Her master's hammer, and his master's: the haft is black with three smiths' hands. Gwen would very much like it back.

abbey_stone.name: Abbey stone
abbey_stone.description: Abbey stone, tool stone. Teleport abbey, Cooldown ticks 3000. Made in the valley of Ashvale.
